item.title: Gloria Steinem, a potent voice of US feminism and co-founder of Ms. Magazine, dies at 92
item.description: Gloria Steinem, the most visible symbol and potent voice of the U.S. women’s movement in the ‘60s and ‘70s and a fierce advocate for feminist causes for the rest of her life, has died at 92.
